Argo CD MCP server

Lets an agent read real application state instead of guessing.

WHAT IT IS

An MCP server exposing Argo CD applications, sync status, health and diffs to an agent.

WHAT SETS IT APART

The first item on ArgoCon's agent-ready checklist. Read-only, it gives triage the deploy context it most needs: what changed, when, and whether it's healthy.

WHERE WE STAND

Trial read-only, as one of stage 1's data sources.
